title: SessionEffectSpineOptions
description: Options for createSessionEffectSpine(). Wires the session tool loop into the audited Policy -> Grant -> Receipt spine.

cwd.description: Working directory passed to session tools.

registry.description: TypeScript injection point: AgentToolRegistry. The same AgentTool instances back the spine. Not JSON-serializable.

taskId.description: Stable task identifier for the spine. Composition roots use the session id.

model.description: ModelProfile from @focuscode/agent-runtime: { provider, model, baseUrl, ... }. Not fully JSON-serializable (may carry functions).

approve.description: TypeScript injection point: ApprovalHandler. Bridges PolicyEngine approvals to the session handler. Omit to deny all. Not JSON-serializable.

onApprovalRequired.description: TypeScript injection point: (request: PermissionRequest) => void | Promise<void>. Fires before approve(). Not JSON-serializable.
